{{Top|leg}}
'''Reflection Prospect''' was a large public square in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Calimondretta]], the [[Arkadianate]] capital on the icy planet of [[Syned]]. It was used as a site of contemplation by Arkadianate subjects. It was situated south of [[Patriot Hall]], which was located near the entry barrier guarding the city's entrance and exit points. The square also had several tubes of [[Synedian algae]] which served as a source of light and heating for the planet's population.

During the [[Siege of Calimondretta]], the square was damaged when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Arkadia Calimondra]] ordered her [[Citizen Guard]]s to deploy [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] in an attempt to stop the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]]. While it failed to kill the Jedi woman, the bombs killed and maimed many civilians and Citizen Guards alike.
